fact_text: Prime Energy, a company in which Hub Power holds a 50% stake, sought oil and gas exploration blocks in Sindh, a notice the PSX announced on the publication date.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUB Power Company Future Plans | New Core Business After IPP? | PSX Stock Analysis 2025' (YouTube, 2025-05-17)

fact_text: ENI, previously an Italian-owned oil and gas business, was sold and its assets moved to Prime Holding, which the analyst said will bring oil and gas well activity into Hub Power's portfolio.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUB Power Company Future Plans | New Core Business After IPP? | PSX Stock Analysis 2025' (YouTube, 2025-05-17)

fact_text: The analyst said Hub Power's legacy base-plant payments will gradually decline and end, so future earnings must come from its newer holdings, such as the China Power Hub Generation stake.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUB Power Company Future Plans | New Core Business After IPP? | PSX Stock Analysis 2025' (YouTube, 2025-05-17)

fact_text: China Power Hub Generation is a 1,320 MW coal-fired plant in which Hub Power holds a 37.5% stake, and it is the main source of Hub's share of associate profits.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUB Power Company Future Plans | New Core Business After IPP? | PSX Stock Analysis 2025' (YouTube, 2025-05-17)

fact_text: Hub Power holds about an 80% stake in Thal Energy, which the analyst said will be a further source of its income.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUB Power Company Future Plans | New Core Business After IPP? | PSX Stock Analysis 2025' (YouTube, 2025-05-17)

fact_text: Hub Power's consolidated EPS for the nine months to March 2025 was about PKR 26, mostly from its share of associate profits, chiefly from China Power Hub Generation.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUB Power Company Future Plans | New Core Business After IPP? | PSX Stock Analysis 2025' (YouTube, 2025-05-17)

fact_text: The analyst projected Hub Power's full-year EPS at about PKR 35 by annualising the nine-month figure, with the June year-end consolidated accounts as the test.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUB Power Company Future Plans | New Core Business After IPP? | PSX Stock Analysis 2025' (YouTube, 2025-05-17)

fact_text: The analyst expects new portfolio assets, including BYD vehicle assembly through Mega Motors, a battery pack power plant and a smelting plant with Chinese investment, to generate cash flows from FY27.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUB Power Company Future Plans | New Core Business After IPP? | PSX Stock Analysis 2025' (YouTube, 2025-05-17)

fact_text: The analyst compared Hub Power's shift to a portfolio of listed holdings with the earlier Engro Corporation model, where many listed companies fed income to the parent.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUB Power Company Future Plans | New Core Business After IPP? | PSX Stock Analysis 2025' (YouTube, 2025-05-17)

fact_text: The analyst viewed Hub Power as fairly valued in the short term, with its longer-term case depending on how the new portfolio assets add earnings.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUB Power Company Future Plans | New Core Business After IPP? | PSX Stock Analysis 2025' (YouTube, 2025-05-17)

fact_text: The analyst expects Hub Power's dividend yield to fall from the 15% to 20% levels of the past to around 7%, as its earnings base shifts.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUB Power Company Future Plans | New Core Business After IPP? | PSX Stock Analysis 2025' (YouTube, 2025-05-17)

fact_text: Fauji Fertilizer went ex-dividend on 8 May 2025 for a first-quarter dividend of PKR 7 per share.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUB Power Company Future Plans | New Core Business After IPP? | PSX Stock Analysis 2025' (YouTube, 2025-05-17)

fact_text: Fauji Fertilizer's first-quarter 2025 EPS was about PKR 12 per share, more than the PKR 7 first-quarter dividend.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUB Power Company Future Plans | New Core Business After IPP? | PSX Stock Analysis 2025' (YouTube, 2025-05-17)

fact_text: A urea bag was priced at about PKR 400 on the publication date, which the analyst said keeps fertilizer makers' pricing intact.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUB Power Company Future Plans | New Core Business After IPP? | PSX Stock Analysis 2025' (YouTube, 2025-05-17)

fact_text: The analyst said farm economics are weak: farmers are not getting support prices for wheat and other crops, sugarcane is the main income, and tractor sales have been low.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUB Power Company Future Plans | New Core Business After IPP? | PSX Stock Analysis 2025' (YouTube, 2025-05-17)

fact_text: The analyst said Fauji Fertilizer has the largest market share in urea sales in Pakistan, so its volumes should hold up even while farm economics are weak.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUB Power Company Future Plans | New Core Business After IPP? | PSX Stock Analysis 2025' (YouTube, 2025-05-17)
